title: Three Years and One Short Lever
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：panel　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 panel 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the engineer ① fitted the panel that no worker in the workshop would have counted, and he said the fitting was the whole of the year. The ② panel, meaning the board itself and not the lever, ran three years and stayed uncounted in the book; a panel, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ panel in that workshop had the same short lever beside it, and the ④ panel at the far bench, meaning the part they kept for the children to fit and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A panel, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the engineer said the counting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the panel was the whole of the matter, meaning the counsel and not the board. The ⑥ panel, meaning the counsel and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; panel, he said, is either something you fit or the only word that means both a board and a counsel. He said the counsel is the part they remember.

By 1977 the ⑦ panel had become a line in a manual, and the manual had become an argument about the short lever. The ⑧ panel of the whole thing, the engineer wrote in April, was one workshop and three years of counting; panel, he said, is either the part at the far bench or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ panel I remember is the board counted in the manual, which closed in 1979 and is still counted as the quietest in the workshop. A ⑩ panel, my mother said in 1981, is the only board that improves by being counted; every panel, she said, is a counsel that has agreed to look like a board. She said the counsel was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 面板；评议小组（指车间里每一块旁边的那一块）
B. n. 面板；评议小组（指那块面板本身，与短短的拉杆相对）
C. 固定搭配：fit the panel 装这一块面板
D. n. 面板；评议小组（指留给孩子们装的那一件）
E. n. 面板之事（抽象总称，指一处车间的面板之事）
F. n. 面板；评议小组（指说明书里写到、被清点的那一块）
G. n. 面板、众议（指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 众议（抽象总称，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: fitted the panel that no worker in the workshop would have counted
The panel, meaning the board itself and not the lever
the panel at the far bench
the panel was the whole of the matter
the panel had become a line in a manual
The panel of the whole thing
A panel, my mother said in 1981

answers.why: fit the panel 意为“装这一块面板”，1972 年那位工程师把车间里没有一位工人肯清点的一块面板做了一遍。
panel 意为“面板；评议小组”，指那块面板本身而不是短短的拉杆，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被清点。
panel 意为“面板；评议小组”，指车间里每一块旁边的那一块，每一块旁边都有同一根短短的拉杆。
panel 意为“面板；评议小组”，指最远那张工作台的留给孩子们装的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
panel 意为“面板、众议”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这块众议就是那件事的全部。
panel 意为“众议”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那块面板，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
panel 意为“面板；评议小组”，指说明书里写到、被清点的那一块，到 1977 年这一块成了说明书里的一行。
panel 意为“面板之事”，工程师四月写道，整件事的面板之事是一处车间和三个年头的清点。
panel 意为“面板；评议小组”，我记得的是说明书里清点过的那一块，1979 年装好了，至今仍被说成车间里最安静的一块。
panel 为抽象总称，母亲 1981 年说，面板是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的面板。
